title: Enabling interspecies epigenomic comparison with CEpBrowser
Enabling interspecies epigenomic comparison with CEpBrowser-Summary

paragraphs.origin_text: We developed the Comparative Epigenome Browser (CEpBrowser) to allow the public to perform multi-species epigenomic analysis. The web-based CEpBrowser integrates, manages and visualizes sequencing-based epigenomic datasets. Five key features were developed to maximize the efficiency of interspecies epigenomic comparisons.

title: Enabling interspecies epigenomic comparison with CEpBrowser-Availability

paragraphs.origin_text: CEpBrowser is a web application implemented with PHP, MySQL, C and Apache. URL: http://www.cepbrowser.org/.
